pose.scope: Static body compositions, supported hand gestures and independent finger edits for Genesis 8 Female, Genesis 8 Male and Genesis 9.
limits: Complete instruction and creative-variety gates have not passed. Review each alternative before Apply.

controlled-edit.scope: Sparse local edits and broader recomposition from an accepted pose, with protected regions and compatible pins.
limits: Broader edits can still fail fitting. A conflicting or unverified result is not accepted.

floor.scope: Bounded seated, kneeling, lying, crawling and supported inverted poses, with explicit support checks.
limits: Support proxies do not establish natural balance. One-hand balances and unsupported contacts require Studio adjustment. No authored fallback replaces a failed Kimodo proposal.

interaction.scope: Front and side hugs, hip-height handholding, and owned hand-to-shoulder contacts across the three Genesis rigs.
limits: 47 of 48 base proxy scenes and all 47 attempted compatible-pin replays passed. One reversed Genesis 9 side hug still rejects. Custom surface contacts and other layouts remain unqualified.

clue-body.scope: Estimated source uncertainty for the initial unprompted SAM body prior only.
limits: Regional review of the initial body estimate is available. Final-pose accuracy and distance between people are excluded.
Warm overhead and unchanged extraction-output parity have not passed qualification. Uncertainty is not a guaranteed error bound.

relative-spacing.scope: Optional bounded translation from learned torso-surface depth in the reference camera, with Preview, Apply and Cancel.
limits: Synthetic surface ordering is promising; final placement improvement is not qualified. Reference-camera depth is not verified physical distance or automatically DAZ world Z. Weak or conflicting evidence retains the current layout.
